summary: Fulvia Palladino (about 1708–1774) of Aiello Calabro in Calabria; John's 8th-great-grandmother through a Fiorillo and Fata line that is not yet proven.
bio: Fulvia Palladino was born about 1708 and died on 2 September 1774 at Aiello Calabro, Cosenza, Calabria, Italy. She is placed as John's 8th-great-grandmother through the Fiorillo and Fata line, a descent that has not yet been supported by records.
